title: TD.J3B Imported dose and schedule
description: What the clinic records for each imported dose's vaccine code, and what the national schedule finds due once the doses are counted.

productCode.description: The vaccine code as the issuer signed it; kept, never replaced (STD-SEM-001).

scheduleCode.description: The schedule's antigen-and-dose code of the dose due.

dueDose.description: A dose of the national schedule the evaluation finds due (decision table TD.DT.04).
